Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid Century Modern Concrete Planter Flower Pot Set - Pack of 3, 5 x 3 x 2 Inch, White and Gold
Colors: Grey
The cracks and chips in these concrete planters are filled with gold paint for a shimmery detail. Designed for succulents and air plants, these planters are perfect to decorate a table or window sill. Each planter is handmade by a local artist in northeast Indiana. 5"L x 3"W x 2"H Designed for succulents and air plants Felt pads underneath prevent scratching surfaces Made by hand in the United States No additional drip tray required as the bottom is solid Since each piece is handmade expect variations
